      <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4476">rgyal ba'i yum bar ma le'u brgyad pa nyi khri lnga stong ba mdo' 'grel rnam par bshad pa</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">bla ma rje brtsun</rs> gyi gsung la dka' ba mang pos nan tan byas nas <lb n="134b6"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3806">shakya'i dge slong blo gros 'byung gnas</rs> kyis rjed byang du bkod pa rdzogs s+ho ||</seg></TEI>
